title: fix(ui): dashboard KPI values and chart labels stay readable on a phone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoTrt9MbRftG8VpmSncerMJE)_

Part of #27520 — rows 3, 15 (the chart half) and 18 (the chart part). Every other row stays on the card.

Clause-②: yes (widening: @object-ui/core gains the public export formatMonthBucketLabel; no accept set moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：仪表盘在手机上的可读性。KPI 大数字放不下时自动缩小而不是被截断；按月分桶的图表轴显示 "Oct 2025" 而不是 "2025-10"；柱图/面积图的图例补上色块，对比（compareTo）系列的色块画成空心以和主系列区分；手机上的类目标签不再被截成 "In Progr…"（横向柱图换行显示，竖向柱图旋转显示，仍被截断的标签悬停可见全名）。
- **为什么改**：18.3.0 RC 走查（#27520 第 3、15、18 行）在 390px 手机上看到 Total Budget 显示成 "$1,090,00..."，CRM Pipeline 仪表盘的对比系列与主系列同色、阶段柱图图例没有色块、月份轴是原始键。
- **风险与回滚**：只改渲染层（三个 `@object-ui` 包），不碰 spec、元数据和数据；数据行里的月份键不变，下钻与排序不受影响。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx`（标签格式化、两个刻度组件、图例色块）；`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/metricTile.ts`（数据集 KPI 的字号阶梯）；`ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartContainerImpl.tsx`（图例色块）。
- **两分钟验证**：手机宽度（390px）打开 showcase 的 Delivery Operations 仪表盘，Total Budget 应完整显示 `$1,090,000.00`；打开 CRM 的 Pipeline Dashboard，趋势图 X 轴应为 "Oct 2025 … Oct 2026"，图例里 "vs last year" 是空心色块。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Row 3 — a dataset-bound KPI value shrinks before it clips.** `DatasetWidget`'s metric tile drew every value at the short face (20 px, 24 px from a 160 px tile), so `$1,090,000.00` clipped in a phone's two-per-row tile. It now takes `METRIC_TILE_DATASET_VALUE_LADDER` in `metricTile.ts`: the same rungs as the plain tiles' ladder (objectui#12942), measured against the dataset tile's own box (no Card inset), never drawing 24 px under 160 px. Past the last rung the value keeps the ellipsis and carries the full figure as its tooltip. A short value keeps today's face and draws no tooltip. Compact notation (`$1.09M`) was not needed: shrink-to-fit holds the figure on a 390 px phone, and it would override the measure's declared `format`.
- **Row 15 — month axis.** `@object-ui/core` gains `formatMonthBucketLabel(value, locale)` (`utils/date-bucket-label.ts`): a `YYYY-MM` bucket key reads `Oct 2025` in the display locale, formatted in UTC so no zone moves it a month; anything else answers `undefined` and keeps its text. The chart's category label reads it. The row's key is untouched, so drill-through and ordering are unchanged. The line/area edge inset (objectui#13390) is now sized from that face (`Mmm 0000`) instead of `0000-00`.
- **Row 15 — legend swatches.** A bar or area mark fills from a gradient, so recharts handed the legend `url(#…)`, which no swatch can draw: every bar chart's legend had no swatch. `AdvancedChartImpl` now hands `ChartLegendContent` a per-series `LegendSwatch` (the colour the mark is drawn in). A `compareTo` overlay keeps its primary's hue (it mirrors it on purpose) and its swatch is drawn hollow, the way its mark is muted, so the two read apart. A lone bar series painted per category (semantic option colours) draws its label with no swatch, since no one colour names it.
- **Row 18 — category labels on a phone.** The phone cut to eight characters lived in the shared category formatter, so it hit every axis. Now:
  - the horizontal-bar category axis draws each label whole, wrapped into the axis width (sized from the widest label, 60–140 px) to at most two lines, through `WrappedCategoryTick`; a label still too long ends in `…` with the full text as an SVG title;
  - on the vertical x axis the cut moved into `xAxisTickFormatter`, so the fit and rotation decisions measure the full label: a phone's few buckets rotate and draw `In Progress` whole (the rotated cap of 12 characters holds it). An unrotated label on a phone, and a rotated one past 12 characters, are still cut, and `TitledCategoryTick` (recharts' own `Text`) carries the full label as its tooltip.

The widget descriptions on the CRM Pipeline dashboard that leak authoring notes ("Pie/donut/funnel ignore `compareTo`", "(compareTo)") are example content in `examples/app-crm/src/dashboards/pipeline.dashboard.ts`; not edited here, per the order.

## Tests

- New: `ui/packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/date-bucket-label.test.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.dashboardReadability-27520.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/metricTileDatasetValueScale-27520.test.tsx`.
- Adapted, because they pinned the behaviour this changes:
  - `AdvancedChartImpl.pointAxisEdgeLabels-13390` and `AdvancedChartImpl.missingCategoryKey` read the month labels as `Aug 2026` / `Jan 2026`; the edge-inset geometry assertions are unchanged and pass.
  - `AdvancedChartImpl.labelFitBand-13241` asserted the full name was absent from the chart's whole `textContent`; the tick's tooltip now carries it, so the assertion reads the drawn labels and pins the tooltip.
  - `metricTileLayout-12623` pins the short face, and its fixture `1964500` is now past the short rung, so it uses `196450`; the long value is pinned in the new 27520 file.
- Ablations, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with an on-disk restore to the HEAD blob: removing the month label, the dataset ladder, the legend swatch colour or the wrap each turns its new test red (1 failed each). The first month ablation was a no-op (an empty replacement is refused) and was redone with `--delete`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The KPI money half of row 15 does not hold on `main`.** The order says it belongs to #27430 (closed). #27430 shipped the tile caption (PR #27972) and its row 1 is the formula `returnType: currency` face; neither puts a currency on a dataset KPI. Measured on this branch and at `9f13ee81`: the CRM Pipeline dashboard's Total Pipeline tile reads `710,000`, Won This Quarter `235,000`, Avg Deal Size `81,000`, with no currency, while the showcase's Total Budget reads `$1,090,000.00`. Not fixed here; reported to the seat for routing.
- The chart tooltip header still shows a month bucket's raw key (`2025-10`), as it already did for an ISO day; only the axis reads the face.
- The KPI ladder's em table is an upper estimate, so on a 390 px phone Total Budget draws at 14 px with room to spare where 16 px would also fit.

## Verification

Browser, Chromium at 390×844 and 1440×900, Console from this branch's `ui/` src (Vite) against `examples/app-showcase` and `examples/app-crm` booted `--fresh --seed-admin`; the before column is the same stacks with the Console at the merge base `9f13ee81`.

<details><summary>Measured before / after</summary>

| Where | Before (9f13ee81) | After (this branch) |
|---|---|---|
| Showcase Delivery Operations, Total Budget, phone | 20 px, scrollWidth 143 in a 123 px box: clipped | 14 px, 100 px: whole |
| Same, desktop | 24 px, whole | 24 px, whole (unchanged) |
| Showcase Tasks by Status x axis, phone | `In Progr…`, `In Revie…` | `In Progress`, `In Review` (rotated) |
| Showcase Task Throughput x axis | `2026-09`, `2026-10` | `Sep 2026`, `Oct 2026` |
| Showcase Tasks by Status legend | swatch background transparent | no swatch (per-category bars), label only |
| CRM Pipeline Trend x axis | `2025-10` … `2026-10` | `Oct 2025` … `Oct 2026` |
| CRM Pipeline Trend legend | both swatches solid `rgb(36, 99, 235)` | primary solid, `vs last year` hollow (1 px border, same hue) |
| CRM Opportunities by Stage legend | both swatches transparent (`url(#…)`) | primary solid, `vs previous period` hollow |
| CRM Opportunities by Stage x axis, phone | `Prospect…`, `Qualific…`, `Closed W…` | `Prospecting`, `Qualificati…` (title: Qualification), `Closed Won` |

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

At head `23380e90` (this branch merged with `origin/main` at `35f20551`):

- Under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, the `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard...` + `@object-ui/plugin-charts...` closure build, `type-check` of `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-charts` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, then `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/core/ packages/plugin-charts/ packages/plugin-dashboard/`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`; Test Files 523 passed (523), Tests 7418 passed, 42 skipped (7460).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 35 commands, each run with `</dev/null`, all `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` was SIGKILLed on its first run (the box was out of memory with the browser stacks still up); rerun alone after stopping them: exit 0, Test Files 169 passed, 2 skipped (171), Tests 4901 passed, 2 skipped.
- Also run: `pnpm --dir ui check:new-line-citations` exit 0 (outside the derivation), `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0.

</details>
